fast.$description: Milliseconds. Instant feedback, e.g. a button shrinking on press.

base.$description: Milliseconds. Small state changes such as State Layer fades on hover.

slow.$description: Milliseconds. Settling back to rest, e.g. a button releasing after press.

standard.$description: CSS timing function: fast start, smooth stop. Use for all state transitions. In prototypes, set Smart Animate to Custom bezier 0.2, 0, 0, 1.

pressed.$description: Scale applied to the visible layers of a pressed control (pointer and keyboard). The clickable area never shrinks. Not applied under reduced motion.
